cohort: The study included 221 consecutive nulliparous women attending antenatal clinic registration at Central Hospital Agbor, Delta state, Nigeria.
finding: The study found that 70.6% of nulliparous women preferred vaginal delivery, 5.4% preferred Caesarean section, and 24.0% had no preference but would accept CS if advised by a doctor, with advanced maternal age, occupation, and previous miscarriage significantly associated with CS preference.
